ValidationRule.description: If Request Card Type = Platinum Balance Transfer/ila switch then Balance Transfer Type is Mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(cc_Requested_Card_Type__c, "PLATINUM_BALANCE_TRANSFER_01"), ISPICKVAL(cc_Balance_Transfer_Type__c, ""), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Balance Transfer Type field.
